chapterInfo.content:
8
Nnisoɔ ho setie
1Hwan na ɔte sɛ onyansafoɔ no,
na hwan na ɔnim asɛm ase kyerɛ?
Onipa nyansa ma n’anim hyerɛn,
na n’anim denyɛ sakyera.
2Mese#8.2 MESE: Adeyɛ se no nni Hebri Atwerɛ no mu. Di ɔhene anomu asɛm so, na ɛsiane Onyankopɔn ntam a woaka no nti, ɛmma no nnha wo; 3firi n’anim kɔ; sɛ asɛm no nyɛ dɛ a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase, 4ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ deɛ ɛsɔ n’ani biara. Ɔhene anomu asɛm biara di mu, na hwan na ɔbɛtumi aka akyerɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woreyɛ yi? 5Deɛ ɔdi mmara asɛm soɔ no nnim asɛmmɔne biara, na onyansafoɔ akoma nim berɛ ne atemmuo. 6#Ɔsɛ 3.1 Na ɛberɛ ne atemmuo wɔ hɔ ma nneyɛɛ nyinaa, na onipa bɔne dɔɔso ne so ma no. 7#Ɔsɛ 10.14 Na obi nni hɔ a ɔnim deɛ ɛbɛba, na sɛdeɛ ɛbɛba no, hwan na ɔbɛtumi akyerɛ no? 8Onipa bi nni honhom so tumi, sɛ ɔde bɛsi honhom no kwan, na owuda so tumi nni hɔ, na ɛkwanma nni ɔsa mu, na bɔne mma ne yɛfoɔ mfiri mu mfi.
Ɛwie ateneneefoɔ ne abɔnefoɔ pɛ
9Yei nyinaa mahunu na mede m’akoma ato adwuma a wɔyɛ no owia yi ase nyinaa so: Ɛberɛ bi wɔ hɔ a onipa di onipa so tumi ma no dane no ɔhaw.
10Na saa nso na mehunuu abɔnefoɔ a wɔsiee wɔn; na berɛ a na wɔte aseɛ no, na wɔdi kronkronbea hɔ ahyɛmfire na wɔkamfoo wɔn wɔ kuro a wɔdii bɔne wɔ mu no ara mu. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ. 11#Hiob 35.15 Sɛ nneyɛɛ bɔne ho afobusɛm mma mu ntɛmntɛm nti na nnipa mma bɔne ho atirimpɔ ayɛ wɔn akoma ma. 12#Dwom 73.17-26 Sɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni di asɛmmɔne mprɛha na ɔtena hɔ kyɛre a, ɛnyɛ dɛn ara a, menim sɛ ɛbɛsi wɔn a wɔsuro Onyankopɔn na wɔfɛre no no yie. 13Na ɛrenwie ɔbɔnefoɔ yie, na ɔremma ne nna nkyɛ, ɔte sɛ sunsum, ɛnam sɛ ɔmfɛre Onyankopɔn ntira.
14 # Ɔsɛ 7.15 Ahuhudeɛ bi nso wɔ asase so; sɛ ateneneefoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a adeɛ a ɛfata abɔnefoɔ nneyɛɛ bɛto wɔn, na abɔnefoɔ bi nso wɔ hɔ a adeɛ a ɛfata ateneneefoɔ nneyɛɛ bɛto wɔn. Mekaa sɛ yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ. 15#Ɔsɛ 2.24 Ɛnna mekamfoo anigyeɛ, sɛ papa nni hɔ mma onipa owia yi ase, gye sɛ ɔdidi na ɔnom na n’ani gye, na yei ara na ɛfam ne ho ne brɛ mu, ne nkwa nna a Onyankopɔn de ama no owia yi aseɛ no mu.
16Mede m’akoma mehwehwɛɛ sɛ mɛhunu nyansa, na mahwɛ ɔbrɛ adwuma a wɔyɛ no asase soɔ no, sɛ awia ne anadwo mpo onipa nnya nna, n’aniwa mu no, 17#Ɔsɛ 3.11 ɛnna mehunuu Nyankopɔn nneyɛɛ nyinaa, sɛ onipa ntumi nhunu nnoɔma a wɔyɛ no owia yi aseɛ no, sɛdeɛ onipa bɛbrɛ de ahwehwɛ, nanso ɔrenhunu, na sɛ onyansafoɔ nso ka sɛ ɔbɛhunu a, ɔrentumi nhunu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Hwan na ɔte sɛ onyansafoɔ no,
na hwan na ɔnim asɛm ase kyerɛ?
Onipa nyansa ma n’anim hyerɛn,
na n’anim denyɛ sakyera.
Mese Di ɔhene anomu asɛm so, na ɛsiane Onyankopɔn ntam a woaka no nti, ɛmma no nnha wo; firi n’anim kɔ; sɛ asɛm no nyɛ dɛ a, ntwentwɛn wo nan ase, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ deɛ ɛsɔ n’ani biara. Ɔhene anomu asɛm biara di mu, na hwan na ɔbɛtumi aka akyerɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woreyɛ yi? Deɛ ɔdi mmara asɛm soɔ no nnim asɛmmɔne biara, na onyansafoɔ akoma nim berɛ ne atemmuo. Na ɛberɛ ne atemmuo wɔ hɔ ma nneyɛɛ nyinaa, na onipa bɔne dɔɔso ne so ma no. Na obi nni hɔ a ɔnim deɛ ɛbɛba, na sɛdeɛ ɛbɛba no, hwan na ɔbɛtumi akyerɛ no? Onipa bi nni honhom so tumi, sɛ ɔde bɛsi honhom no kwan, na owuda so tumi nni hɔ, na ɛkwanma nni ɔsa mu, na bɔne mma ne yɛfoɔ mfiri mu mfi.

Yei nyinaa mahunu na mede m’akoma ato adwuma a wɔyɛ no owia yi ase nyinaa so: Ɛberɛ bi wɔ hɔ a onipa di onipa so tumi ma no dane no ɔhaw.
Na saa nso na mehunuu abɔnefoɔ a wɔsiee wɔn; na berɛ a na wɔte aseɛ no, na wɔdi kronkronbea hɔ ahyɛmfire na wɔkamfoo wɔn wɔ kuro a wɔdii bɔne wɔ mu no ara mu. Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ. Sɛ nneyɛɛ bɔne ho afobusɛm mma mu ntɛmntɛm nti na nnipa mma bɔne ho atirimpɔ ayɛ wɔn akoma ma. Sɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni di asɛmmɔne mprɛha na ɔtena hɔ kyɛre a, ɛnyɛ dɛn ara a, menim sɛ ɛbɛsi wɔn a wɔsuro Onyankopɔn na wɔfɛre no no yie. Na ɛrenwie ɔbɔnefoɔ yie, na ɔremma ne nna nkyɛ, ɔte sɛ sunsum, ɛnam sɛ ɔmfɛre Onyankopɔn ntira.
Ahuhudeɛ bi nso wɔ asase so; sɛ ateneneefoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a adeɛ a ɛfata abɔnefoɔ nneyɛɛ bɛto wɔn, na abɔnefoɔ bi nso wɔ hɔ a adeɛ a ɛfata ateneneefoɔ nneyɛɛ bɛto wɔn. Mekaa sɛ yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ. Ɛnna mekamfoo anigyeɛ, sɛ papa nni hɔ mma onipa owia yi ase, gye sɛ ɔdidi na ɔnom na n’ani gye, na yei ara na ɛfam ne ho ne brɛ mu, ne nkwa nna a Onyankopɔn de ama no owia yi aseɛ no mu.
Mede m’akoma mehwehwɛɛ sɛ mɛhunu nyansa, na mahwɛ ɔbrɛ adwuma a wɔyɛ no asase soɔ no, sɛ awia ne anadwo mpo onipa nnya nna, n’aniwa mu no, ɛnna mehunuu Nyankopɔn nneyɛɛ nyinaa, sɛ onipa ntumi nhunu nnoɔma a wɔyɛ no owia yi aseɛ no, sɛdeɛ onipa bɛbrɛ de ahwehwɛ, nanso ɔrenhunu, na sɛ onyansafoɔ nso ka sɛ ɔbɛhunu a, ɔrentumi nhunu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
